verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a native Segments feature. Membership is based on attribute conditions, and profiles 'join' segments, which can trigger automations; that implies membership updates as data changes. Example segments like 'Have not logged in recently' hint at behavioral criteria, and an AI 'Describe segment' builder exists. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-based segment conditions, any evidence of tag-based segmentation, explicit confirmation that segments recalculate in real time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes

citations.quote: when they join Segments (e.g. they meet attribute conditions)
If you go to the Segments page, you'll see segments like "Paying Customers", "Have not logged in recently" and "Unsubscribed".
When you go to create a segment, you can click **Describe segment** and the agent will help you build a segment from a plain-text description.
